integrity.checks: Finite exact-fraction verifier included; no proof by finite enumeration.
integrity.proof_basis: Block inverse/Jacobi identities, a strict discrete convexity-concavity argument, and continuant formulas.

scientific_limitations: The graph is a simple unit-conductance cycle, the screening is uniform and strictly positive, and observations are noiseless.
No claim for arbitrary weighted graphs, arbitrary kernels, noisy measurements, or spectral-rank-optimal truncation.
The exact runner-up formulas apply to nontrivial divisibility cases; uninspected literature leaves publication-priority uncertainty.
title: Simultaneous entropy and Nyström-trace optimal landmarks on screened cycles
